sentences.text:
Counsel for Respondent :- G.A.,Ram Bali Ram Hon'ble Ashwani Kumar Mishra,J.
Hon'ble Syed Aftab Husain Rizvi,J.
Writ petition filed by the co-accused no. 13906 of 2023 to quash the First Information Report dated 05.08.2023 in Case Crime No. 0536 of 2023, under Sections 376, 504, 506 & 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station Jiyanpur, District Azamgarh has been dismissed as having become infructuous on 12.09.2023 which is reproduced hereinafter:-
"1. Lawyers are abstaining from work today.
Sushila And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72004385/
1
2. Learned AGA for the State-respondent is present.

3. This writ petitions have been filed for quashing the impugned First Information Report dated 05.08.2023 in Case Crime No. 536 of 2023, under Sections 376, 504,
506 IPC and 3/4 D.P. Act, Police Station Jiyanpur, District Azamgarh.

4. Learned A.G.A. for the State-respondents submitted that the charge-sheet no. A 459 of 2023 has been filed on 25.08.2023 in the present case and as such, the cause for filing present writ petition no more survives.
5.
In view of above, the writ petition is dismissed as having become infructuous."
Even otherwise, we find that prima facie allegations made in the FIR discloses existence of cognizable offence.
Whether the allegations are correct or not is an aspect to be inquired into at the stage of investigation/trial.
Since a charge-sheet has already been submitted in the matter, which is not under challenge, we refuse to interfere in the writ petition.
The writ petition is, accordingly, dismissed.
Dismissal of this petition will not preclude the parties from availing/claiming appropriate remdey before the competent forum available under the Code of Criminal Procedure.

Order Date :- 18.9.2023/RA  Sushila And Another vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 18 September, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/72004385/
